title: Personal Checking: ATM fees, surcharge rebates and foreign transaction fee by tier
content:
## Scope

This fee schedule covers card and ATM use away from PCB on a Personal Checking account: PCB's own fee at a non-PCB ATM inside the United States, how many non-PCB ATM operator surcharges are rebated per statement cycle and up to what total, PCB's fee at an ATM outside the United States, and the foreign transaction fee percentage.

## PCB fees at ATMs

| Tier | PCB fee per withdrawal or balance inquiry at a non-PCB ATM inside the United States (USD) | PCB fee per withdrawal at an ATM outside the United States (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 2.50 | 5.00 |
| Student Checking | 0.00 | 5.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 3.00 | 5.00 |
| Interest Checking | 3.00 | 5.00 |
| Premier Checking | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 0.00 | 0.00 |

The fee at an ATM outside the United States is charged instead of the domestic out-of-network fee.

## Operator surcharge rebates and foreign transaction fee

| Tier | Non-PCB ATM operator surcharges rebated per statement cycle | Total operator surcharges rebated per statement cycle (USD) | Foreign transaction fee (percent of the U.S. dollar amount) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 0 | 0.00 | 3.00% |
| Student Checking | 4 | 12.00 | 3.00% |
| Everyday Checking | 0 | 0.00 | 3.00% |
| Interest Checking | 2 | 10.00 | 3.00% |
| Premier Checking | 6 | 30.00 | 1.00% |
| Private Client Checking | Unlimited | No cap | 0.00% |

The foreign transaction fee is charged on each debit card purchase or ATM withdrawal made outside the United States or in a foreign currency.

## Tier contrasts (derived from the tables)

- **Student Checking** has no PCB fee at a domestic non-PCB ATM and rebates up to 4 operator surcharges per cycle, up to 12.00 USD in total.
- **Premier Checking** charges neither PCB ATM fee and has the lowest non-zero foreign transaction fee, 1.00%.
- **Private Client Checking** rebates an unlimited number of surcharges with no total cap, and its foreign transaction fee is 0.00%.
- **Hypothetical cycle**: an Interest Checking owner makes three non-PCB ATM withdrawals in one cycle. With 2 rebates per cycle, the third withdrawal falls beyond the rebate count for that cycle.
